Name: Codex Micro
Overview: Control Codex Desktop tasks and actions from Ulanzi D200 Series in Ulanzi Studio.
Description: Control Codex Desktop with the Ulanzi D200. Windows 10/11 support is experimental in the abartiggut fork. Run npm ci and npm run setup:windows, restart Ulanzi Studio, launch or restart Codex using the Bridge action. macOS setup remains available. Guide: https://github.com/abartiggut/ulanzi/tree/windows-port#installation

Actions.Name: Codex Task 1
Actions.Tooltip: Open recent Codex task slot 1 and show its live status.

Actions.Name: Codex Task 2
Actions.Tooltip: Open recent Codex task slot 2 and show its live status.

Actions.Name: Codex Task 3
Actions.Tooltip: Open recent Codex task slot 3 and show its live status.

Actions.Name: Codex Task 4
Actions.Tooltip: Open recent Codex task slot 4 and show its live status.

Actions.Name: Codex Task 5
Actions.Tooltip: Open recent Codex task slot 5 and show its live status.

Actions.Name: Codex Fast
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle Fast mode for the active Codex task.

Actions.Name: Codex Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Show the remaining Codex usage allowance and focus Codex when pressed.

Actions.Name: Pin Codex Task
Actions.Tooltip: Pin or unpin the active Codex task.

Actions.Name: Latest Task & Scroll
Actions.Tooltip: Press to open the latest Codex task. Turn left to scroll up and right to scroll down.

Actions.Name: Fork Codex Task
Actions.Tooltip: Fork the active Codex task into a new task.

Actions.Name: Steer Codex
Actions.Tooltip: Send the current composer text as steering input to the running task.

Actions.Name: Submit to Codex
Actions.Tooltip: Submit or queue the current Codex composer text.

Actions.Name: Model & Reasoning
Actions.Tooltip: Turn right toward the highest entry and left toward the lowest. Hold and turn to adjust reasoning effort. Stops at both ends.

Actions.Name: Context Navigator
Actions.Tooltip: First turn opens the + / @ context menu. Turn left to move up and right to move down. Click and release to select; hold and turn either way to close. Clicking or holding and turning while the menu is closed does nothing.

Actions.Name: Permission Pilot
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to change the active chat’s permission policy (ASK / REVIEW / FULL). During an approval, turn to select ONCE / CHAT / DENY, then press to submit. ONCE is selected initially. Unavailable options are skipped. For the Full access dialog opened by this dial, press to confirm or turn left to cancel. Closing or changing chats invalidates the confirmation.

Actions.Name: Launch Codex Bridge
Actions.Tooltip: Launch or restart Codex through the local Bridge. A running Codex app is closed gracefully.

Localization.LaunchBridgeHelp: Press to launch Codex Bridge.app. If installation is missing or incomplete, Install / Repair runs first, then launches it. The launcher restarts Codex if it is already running.
Localization.PermissionEncoderHelp: Turn to change the active chat’s permission policy (ASK / REVIEW / FULL). During an approval, turn to select ONCE / CHAT / DENY, then press to submit. ONCE is selected initially. Unavailable options are skipped. For the Full access dialog opened by this dial, press to confirm or turn left to cancel. Closing or changing chats invalidates the confirmation.
Localization.ContextEncoderHelp: First turn opens the + / @ context menu. Turn left to move up and right to move down. Click and release to select; hold and turn either way to close. Clicking or holding and turning while the menu is closed does nothing.
Localization.ModelEncoderHelp: Right moves toward Codex's first model, left toward its last. Hold and turn right/left to raise/lower reasoning effort. Lists stop at both ends without wrapping. The screen shows the model, step position, and effort bars; holding highlights reasoning without changing the selection.
Localization.BridgeSetupDescription: Install, launch, and check the local Codex connection.
Localization.UninstallBridgeDone: Codex Bridge was uninstalled. The Ulanzi plugin and Codex Desktop were kept.
Localization.UninstallBridgeConfirm: Uninstall Codex Bridge and its background service? The Ulanzi plugin and Codex Desktop will not be removed.
Localization.BridgeAppDescription: Codex Bridge.app is a local launcher. If Codex is already running, it asks Codex to quit, then starts the official Codex Desktop executable with loopback-only CDP arguments.
Localization.BridgeAppSafety: The launcher does not modify Codex Desktop, accounts, projects, or user files, and it does not expose CDP outside this Mac. It performs no other privileged or destructive operation. The separate Bridge service handles local status and Action communication.
Localization.LaunchAgentDescription: The LaunchAgent starts the local Codex Bridge service when you sign in and restarts it if it exits. The service listens only on this Mac through a loopback address.
Localization.NodeSelectionStrategy: Install / Repair first selects a system Node.js 20 or later from your login environment, PATH, Homebrew, or common install paths. It uses Ulanzi Studio's bundled Node only as a fallback.
Localization.NodeInstallRecommendation: Recommended: install the latest Node.js from Terminal, then run Install / Repair again:
Localization.UlanziNodeSignatureNotice: If the Ulanzi Studio Node fallback is used, macOS Background Items may show an activity carrying the Ulanzi Studio signature. This is the Codex Bridge service running with Ulanzi Studio's Node executable.
